test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
What is the mean of the following distribution?

 
 

 Marks
 12 
 22 
 58 
 79 
 89 
 
 
 
 

 No. of Students
 98
 74
 17
 28
 44
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let the **assumed mean (A)** be 22.

Calculate deviations (dᵢ = xᵢ − 22):

∑fᵢdᵢ = 98×(−10) + 74×0 + 17×36 + 28×57 + 44×67 = −980 + 0 + 612 + 1596 + 2948 = 4176

Total frequency (N) = 98 + 74 + 17 + 28 + 44 = 261

Actual Mean = A + (∑fᵢdᵢ ÷ N) = 22 + (4176 ÷ 261) = 22 + 16 = 38

**∴ The correct answer is 38.**
